varieties.name: Williams (Cavendish)
varieties.supplier_notes: Sweet dessert banana; main commercial type.

timeline_template.description_en: Mark planting holes 3m x 3m. Dig 60cm cubed holes. Mix soil + 2 tins manure.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka alama 3m x 3m. Chimba mashimo 60cm. Changanya na samadi.

timeline_template.description_en: Plant tissue-cultured plantlet 5cm deep. Water immediately.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mche kina 5cm. Mwagilia mara moja.
Weka gramu 200 za DAP kwa shimo.

timeline_template.description_en: Water 30L per plant weekly for 12 weeks if no rain.
timeline_template.description_sw: Mwagilia lita 30 kwa mmea kwa wiki kwa wiki 12.

timeline_template.description_en: Mulch heavily with banana trash or grass. Suppresses weeds + holds moisture.

timeline_template.description_sw: Weka gramu 300 za NPK kwa mmea.

timeline_template.description_en: Keep mother + 1 daughter + 1 grand-daughter. Remove all other suckers.
timeline_template.description_sw: Acha mama + binti + mjukuu. Ondoa ndizi nyingine.

timeline_template.description_en: Second 300g NPK dose at bud emergence.
timeline_template.description_sw: NPK ya pili wakati wa kuanza kwa shada.

timeline_template.description_en: Scout for black sigatoka streaks and bunchy top (stunted upright leaves with streaks). Rogue BBTV immediately.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza sigatoka na bunchy top. Ng'oa BBTV mara moja.

timeline_template.description_en: Prop heavy bunches with forked stake. Wind risk.
timeline_template.description_sw: Simika nguzo ya kushikilia shada nzito. Hatari ya upepo.

timeline_template.description_en: Harvest when fingers fill out, are 3/4 round. Cut whole bunch.
timeline_template.description_sw: Vuna ndizi zikijaa, zikiwa nusu duara. Kata shada lote.
timeline_template.tip_en: After first harvest, plant continues yielding via suckers — perennial.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Baada ya mavuno ya kwanza, mmea unaendelea kupitia vichipukizi.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: bunches 20kg+, no insect damage. Grade B: 10-20kg or minor flaws.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: Whole bunch loaded on padded pickup. Dehanded fingers in 18kg boxes for export.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Cool 13-14°C delays ripening. Don't refrigerate below 12°C — chilling injury.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellowing from older leaves, reddish-brown staining inside the pseudostem, wilt, death; spreads on tools and suckers.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kuwitikia kuanzia majani makubwa, madoa ya kahawia ndani ya shina, kunyauka, kifo; husambaa kwa vifaa na vichipukizi.
diseases.treatment_en: None — destroy mats, biosecurity protocol. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — teketeza mashina, fuata kanuni za usalama wa viumbe. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Clean TC plantlets, disinfect tools, never move soil between fields.
diseases.prevention_sw: Miche safi ya TC, safisha vifaa, usihamishe udongo kati ya mashamba.
diseases.scanner_notes: Internal stem staining is the signature — photograph a cut pseudostem.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellow-brown streaks that blacken, leaf burn from the margins, smaller bunches.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Michirizi ya kahawia inayogeuka nyeusi, majani kuungua kwenye kingo, mashada madogo.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered fungicide programme + de-leafing infected leaves. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ratiba ya dawa zilizoidhinishwa + ondoa majani yaliyoathirika. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Streaks evolving to burnt margins; lower leaves first.

diseases.symptoms_en: Larvae tunnel the corm, dark oozing galleries, plants topple in wind.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Viluwiluwi hutoboa mzizi, matundu meusi yanayotoka maji, mimea huanguka upepo.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered treatments at threshold; trapping. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa wakati wamezidi; mitego. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Clean TC plantlets, remove old stumps, trap.
diseases.prevention_sw: Miche safi ya TC, ondoa mashina kuukuu, tega mitego.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the cut corm — tunnels are the diagnosis.

diseases.symptoms_en: Root galls and lesions, stunted patches, plants topple in wind.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Vidonda na uvimbe kwenye mizizi, mapande dhaifu, mimea huanguka.
diseases.treatment_en: Clean planting material is the control; nematicides where severe. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Miche safi ndio dawa; dawa za nematode pale imekithiri. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

diseases.symptoms_en: Stunted upright leaves with dark green streaks, no bunch production, aphids present.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani mafupi yaliyosimama yenye michirizi ya kijani, hakuna mashada, vidukari wapo.
diseases.treatment_en: None — rogue and destroy immediately. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze mara moja. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Clean plantlets, aphid control, remove infected plants.
diseases.prevention_sw: Miche safi, dhibiti vidukari, ondoa mimea iliyoathirika.
diseases.scanner_notes: Upright stunted leaves + streaks = BBTV; escalate — not a nutrient issue.

diseases.symptoms_en: Ash-grey rot at the bunch tip spreading up the fingers, wet weather.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Uoza wa kijivu kwenye ncha ya shada ukienea juu, mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: Remove the male bud; registered sprays in severe cases. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ondoa ua la kiume; dawa zilizoidhinishwa ikithiri. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Male bud removal after fruit set, airflow.
diseases.prevention_sw: Ondoa ua la kiume baada ya matunda kukaa, hewa.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Year-round bearing — the market never sleeps. The 3-sucker mat system keeps one plant fruiting at all times for 5–8 years per planting.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Kuzaa mwaka mzima — soko halipumziki. Mfumo wa machipukizi 3 hudumisha mmea mmoja ukizaa wakati wote kwa miaka 5–8.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 20–50 KES per kg dessert, cooking slightly lower (November 2026). A well-run acre: 12–20 tonnes per year from month 14.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 20–50 kwa kilo za mezani, za kupika kidogo chini (Novemba 2026). Eka iliyotunzwa vizuri: tani 12–20 kwa mwaka kuanzia mwezi 14.
